pages.text: Put a refining salt in a $(item)Crucible$(), then gold ingots. They come out as $(item)Fine Gold$() of the salt's ★.$(li)$(item)Bone Ash$(): bone meal and charcoal. ★3$(li)$(item)Assay Salt$(): borax and bone ash. ★5$(li)$(item)Sunsalt$(): assay salt and Arcane Dust. ★7
pages.title: Refining

pages.text: Each vat takes four pieces a batch and uses a level of liquid. Better liquids take longer: 2 minutes at ★3, 3 at ★5, 4 at ★7. Right-click with an empty hand to take the batch out, or to see how long it has left.
